# Argon Chat

> Argon Chat is a free desktop voice, messaging and community app built for gamers. It pairs crystal-clear, AI-denoised voice with PlayFrame (real multiplayer games inside a voice call), an in-game overlay that shows who's talking, and coins/levels earned just for hanging out. Core features — voice, messaging, screen sharing and communities — are free; an optional subscription, Ultima, adds cosmetics, larger uploads, higher-quality audio/video and more. Available for Windows and macOS (Linux and mobile in development).
